lines.trans: Drop your weapon right now!
Pasha, why are you killing everyone?
They all wanted to betray me!
Have you no conscience at all?
In this city there is no conscience.
You chose this terrible path yourself.
I simply needed that money!
Money is not worth a human life.
Now everything is already over for me.
Raise your hands and surrender to the authorities.
I do not want to go to prison.
You must answer for your crimes.
You won, Samsonov, take the pistol.
Justice always triumphs in the end.

meanings.en: to leave, to walk out on (someone)

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: идти во власть = go into government

examples.trans: People need to go into government themselves.
I have no idea at all.

meanings.en: to choose, select; to use up completely (quotas, limits)

examples.text: В этом году все квоты выбрали.
examples.trans: This year all the quotas have been used up.
She chose the most beautiful dress.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: забирать деньги = to take the money
забирать детей из школы = to pick the kids up from school

examples.trans: I pick the children up from school.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: the 'е' drops out in the other forms
used predicatively to indicate complete end
goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I have no money at all.

meanings.note: short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: Stop, why did you take a pistol?
The officer put the pistol away in its holster.

meanings.en: to defeat, to beat, to win
meanings.note: 1st person singular is not used in standard Russian

examples.trans: Justice always triumphs in the end.

examples.text: Наша команда регулярно побеждает в турнире.
examples.trans: Our team regularly wins the tournament.

поднять.gloss: to lift, to raise; to rouse

examples.text: Твой дед в войну родину предал.
examples.trans: Your grandfather betrayed his country in the war.
He is suspected of a new crime.
Here is a movie: A Thorny Path.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word
имей совесть! = have a heart! / shame on you!

examples.trans: I fought for the sake of justice!

meanings.note: сколько стоит? = how much is it?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: In prison it will be much worse.

meanings.note: Убивают! = Murder! Help, they're killing me!
уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
To bring into a presentable state.
I'm sick of this communal flat.
